Forward/cyclic calls, missing arguments, incorrect arities, unused definitions, adjacent literals, noncanonical integers, output/work bounds.

D restarts discovery on both raw encoder executions; decoder does not discover programs.
Competing reversible proposals selected using actual complete frame sizes, with a paying shared-binding synthetic case and exact fallback for an unprofitable identity rule.

decoder_cost_limitations: Decoder re-Deflates every reconstructed frame for canonical archive validation; template decoding executes the interpreter again during that check.

Invocation boundary tracing hashes the reconstructed prefix, so measured decoding includes those hash costs. Work and output limits are finite, but this is not evidence of prize-compliant full-corpus throughput.
discovery_scope: Fixed capped complete-page/LF-line proposal pool; exact whole-frame admission over evaluated proposals is not exhaustive grammar optimality.
